title: Stateful framed setup ending in C_IC_NA_1 station interrogation
purpose: Exercise parser state across multiple complete CS104 I-frames, warming with a monitoring APDU and a command APDU before a valid station interrogation request using qualifier 20.
expected_behavior: A CS104 endpoint should parse three successive valid I-frames and reach interrogation-command handling on the final frame with TypeID 100 and interrogation qualifier 20.
constraints_preserved: Each message is a complete CS104 APDU with start byte 0x68 and correct L field
Each message includes 4 APCI control bytes before the ASDU
ASDU core field order is preserved in all frames
First frame uses documented TypeID 1 M_SP_NA_1
Second frame uses documented TypeID 45 C_SC_NA_1
Third frame uses documented TypeID 100 C_IC_NA_1
VSQ is one-object non-sequence in all three frames
Final qualifier byte 20 matches the documented station interrogation qualifier
issue_safety_notes: Uses valid framed traffic only and avoids deadlock or malformed-framing motifs from issue reports while still adding stateful depth.
